Cats

Keiko needs to vent about the Manager and goes on a rant about him Features KEIKO NAKAMA. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

I hate his sweaters. Cat-sweaters. Every single one has a goddamn cat on 'em. And every time he smiles at me and says "good morning" or "oh, look at that sunset over the river" or "mmh, this mocha is perfect" or "oh my god, have you seen Kitty Fluffy Kiss Kiss?". Just shut up! I just wanna tear off his perfect mustache, shoot his cat and dump 'em both in the Potomac. Who'd miss them? Who'd care? Then again, I'm the only person this moron's got in his life... Then all of this is over, maybe I should give them both a merciful death. Just a "hey, go grab me that thing over there on the table" and BLAMO! Yeah, maybe I'll just do that... [1]

Declaration of Will

Being fearful for his life, the Manager Features THE MANAGER, https. Contains 2 dialogue exchanges. [1]

I know. You've often told me how you'd like to see what a high velocity, large caliber bullet would do to her, but I know there's love in you as well. She will only require daily cat food. If in a pinch, every second day will also do. Pets. Not bullets - pets. She likes to be pet. Softly. Kindly. If not daily, if not weekly, then monthly. Or bi-monthly if I knew you well enough. Anyway, I trust you to respect my last wish. Thanks, Keiko. [1]
